player_actions: Voluntarily ends sitting meditation, joins Hayase Nori's inner Kusa security field team going to officially closed Research Building No.3.

To Kuroda, directs maximal vigilance, increase guard staffing and immediate emergency communications. Shiki does NOT choose to attack, seize teenager, treat anyone, enter building, or decide tactical direction at site yet.

timeline.event: Shiki tells field captain Nori his prior personal hospital guard decision changed and he will go with her, entrusts defense to Kuroda with instruction increased guards and immediate threat report. Nori states she remains group field commander but respects Shiki autonomy in battle. Kuroda autonomously arranges two extra guards inside secured ICU zone, two at entrance, two at stairs, reroutes badge verification and keeps signal scroll. Ritsu knows Shiki leaving; patient remains alive under positive pressure ventilation, unnamed IV continuing, Tiyo supervised. No ANBU deployment confirmed.

Nori leads compact security unit to Research Building No3 through south medical district. Team includes 2 field close-combat officers and sensory chunin Мэдзима Гэнта (thin, sardonic until urgent work). Building abandoned for patient admission since 1281 cooling failure; planned investigation and patrol separate tracking unmarked freight wagon south to ferry, no report yet. No extra Shiki jutsu or personal choices on travel assigned. Rain and old derelict compound.

Security group reaches boarded building over stone fence; fresh heavy wagon tracks lead south; smaller dolly/trolley track returns inward after rain. Genta probes limited chakra through stone/metal and counts 4 energy signatures inside: 2 moving, one largely still, a fourth weak/uneven, but reading cannot identify people. Shiki with high sensory capacity also sees vague separate source signatures at range, not intimate condition. No invented identities.

Service side door 20m from team opens, broad-shouldered armed man in rain cloak and dark-service-uniform woman pushing narrow metal medical crate on small dolly. Woman sees Nori Kusa security and Shiki, freezes and calls 'Охрана!'. Armed man sees Kusa headbands, draws and throws 3 kunai without warning, 2 at Nori/Genta and third at old hanging oil lantern. Nori ordered surrender, deflects blade; Genta ducks unhit. Lantern bursts burning oil into stacked wooden boxes near crate, spreading fire. Nori autonomously calls 'ЖИВЫМИ! ЕСЛИ ВОЗМОЖНО!' and sets 2 Kusa fighters on armed man, who crouches behind steel crate as cover. Woman struggles to keep cargo from leaving yard.

During movement medical crate door briefly opens, exposing apparent male adolescent ~16yo, short dark hair, pale, eyes closed, subtle chest movement, bracelet/plaque at wrist with SIX pits matching visual motif from prior patient but not definitive relationship. Contents only visible momentarily before woman hastily shuts. Woman calls not to damage container. Unknown deep male voice from inside building orders 'Оставьте груз'; woman's body freezes and she protests while armed man snaps back, voice repeats. Nori orders Genta to watch side door. A human right arm now appears in doorway, unknown armed/unarmed and still mostly inside. Flammable wooden boxes burning ~8m from crate, real hazard to life/cargo. Shiki still ~18m from trolley, armed man~17m, woman~19m, team nearby and starting fight; unknown man inside cannot be identified at cut. No Shiki attack or movement attributed.
